name: --any-disc
purpose: Launcher: with --import-stat-pack, the disc image is taken as it is and not held to the unchanged disc (a pack made against another image is another pack).

name: --bundle
purpose: Launcher: with --prepare-disc, another mod bundle than the launcher's (tests and development).

name: --config
purpose: Launcher and runner: a launch file, plain JSON with an "about" line. The runner's (port/moderngekko/src/switches.cpp; protocol/formats.md section 2) holds every setting of a game's start: the race or the replay, the bundle, and the test settings in its "debug" part; the launcher writes one for each game it starts. The launcher's own (net/src/Launcher.Core/Files/LaunchConfig.cs) names the launcher's test settings in its "debug" object, and hands "autopilot", "testLagMs" and "game" on to its games. Without a "debug" part every test setting is off; a member a reader does not know is refused. Two test settings are outside "debug" (protocol/formats.md section 2, "The latency test settings"): the runner's "present" ("console" or "copy": when a picture goes to the screen) and a race's "delay" below 2, which the launcher writes from its settings file's "present" and "inputDelay" (0, 1 or 2, never more; net/src/Launcher.Core/Settings.cs); each is named in the game's log when on.

name: --data
purpose: Launcher: another data folder than the player's (tests and development).

name: --dev-service
purpose: Launcher: dev mode, the window on the stand-in service in the launcher's own process (net/src/Launcher.Core/StandIn): a lobby, players, chat, the votes and the machine stage without a server or keys; races do not start. Never on without the switch.

name: --disc
purpose: Launcher: with --import-stat-pack, the disc image the changed car data is compared with (without it, the settings' disc).

name: --fzgx-log
purpose: The launcher passes it to the runner it starts: the file for the runner's output (the runner's row is in port/switches.tsv).

name: --import-stat-pack
purpose: Launcher: a stat pack file made of every value of this changed car data file (cardata.lz, or unpacked) that differs from the disc's own, without the window.

name: --list-replays
purpose: Launcher: the replay folder's replays as the Replays page lists them, one line each, without the window.

name: --out
purpose: Launcher: with --import-stat-pack, the file the pack is written to (without it, beside the car data file).

name: --overwrite
purpose: Launcher: with --import-stat-pack, a file already at the pack's place is replaced.

name: --pack-author
purpose: Launcher: with --import-stat-pack, who made the pack: its file's author line (1 to 40 plain characters), shown beside the pack's name in a lobby and on the status page.

name: --main-module
purpose: Launcher: with --import-stat-pack, a mod's modified enemy_line/line__.bin: the game's code constants it changes that a pack may carry go into the pack too; every other change is named and left out.

name: --pack-name
purpose: Launcher: with --import-stat-pack, the pack's name.

name: --play-match
purpose: Launcher: the game started on the race of this match file, without the window.

name: --play-controller-setup
purpose: Launcher: the game started on its own controller options (Options, Controller), without the window; it closes when the player leaves them. What the Controller page's "Set up in the game" starts.

name: --play-offline
purpose: Launcher: the game started for offline play, without the window.

name: --play-replay
purpose: Launcher: the game playing this replay file back, without the window.

name: --prepare-disc
purpose: Launcher: the game's files prepared from this disc image into the data folder, without the window.

name: --replay
purpose: Launcher: with --play-match, the file the race is recorded to (default: the replay folder, named by the time and the match).

name: --report
purpose: Launcher: with --import-stat-pack, every difference of the changed file from the disc is listed with what the game's ranges say of it (in range, untried, refused and why), then the totals; nothing is written.

name: FZGX_FUZZ_OUT
purpose: The folder an input that broke a launcher reader is written to (default: the temporary folder).

name: FZGX_FUZZ_SECONDS
purpose: Seconds each launcher fuzz test runs; unset: a short fixed loop in the ordinary suite.

name: FZGX_FUZZ_SEED
purpose: The launcher fuzz tests' random seed (default 20261006).
